title: lecanopteris vieillardii
intro: Lecanopteris vieillardii, commonly known as Vieillard's antler fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Pacific Islands, to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Lecanopteris vieillardii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are used to treat conditions such as fever, cough, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation and fighting off infections.
